name: The majority voted in favour of a [Government amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-05-16.238.3). This means the amendment was successful and that it will now become part of the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 4, page 55 (after line 18), after Part 2, insert:* > >> *Part 2A — Membership of Parliamentary Joint Committee on Human Rights* >> >> *Human Rights (Parliamentary Scrutiny) Act 2011* >> >> *10A Subsection 5(1)* >> >>> *Omit "10", substitute "12".* >> >> *10B Paragraphs 5(1)(a) and (b)* >> >>> *Omit "5", substitute "6".*
